findings.ancestry: Published code enumerates original DAGs, computes d-separation and Markov-equivalence-class causal relations, then fills deterministic premise/hypothesis templates. Original train has no CLadder or other Decision Index corpus import, model output, paraphrase or teacher target in this generation path.
findings.paper: Live original paper describes exhaustive graph generation, correlation/conditional-independence premises and binary validity defined across compatible graphs. Finetuned MNLI models and GPT evaluations in the repository are consumers, not inputs to original data generation.
findings.parser_adaptation: Pinned verbalizer credits coauthor Zhiheng Lyu for the embedded raw-graph parser. Its linked Colab required login through TinyFish; the actual embedded parser and upstream C++ generator were inspected and hash-frozen, and do not fetch notebook contents or text corpora.
findings.hub_card: Pinned card lists original train/test/validation CSVs and perturbation configurations, and otherwise says TODO. License evidence comes from the authors upstream repository, which explicitly publishes code and data together, not from a search tag.
findings.independence_limit: Source-path inspection establishes synthetic-generation ancestry. Only the lead full-suite scan can admit this pinned source; unavailable private tests and base-model pretraining remain outside this evidence.
findings.separate_story_path: data_realworld.py calls GPT-3.5 to write dev/test story files only. It does not write original train or the ten frozen Hub release files. No story files or model-written derivatives are used or admitted.
